_doc: The music edit of every reel, written as bars of the track. tools/films.py turns it into the segment list the mixer reads. One track for the whole series: Playground Fun by Ahjay Stelino (Mixkit 12), 130 BPM, C major, bar n starts at t0 + n * bar seconds (measured by the real-sound arranger). Its harmony, bar by bar: 0-7 C C Am Am F F G G; 36-39 F F G G; 40-43 F F Em C (bar 40 is the track's big entrance); 93-97 C F G C C (its ending: the last chord is on bar 96). Every reel opens on bar 0, puts bar 40 on its reveal and bar 96 on the logo. Splices keep the harmony moving: C to G, Em to C (what the track plays there anyway), F to F, Em to G.

01-crayon-to-cartoon: C: the track's opening under the hook
G | F F: bar 40, the big entrance, on the cartoon landing
F | G | C: the ending, last chord on the logo
02-meet-anna-kamilla: C C: the opening under the two portraits
G | F F | Em: bar 40 on Anna's portrait
C | F | G | C: the ending, last chord on the logo
04-idea-to-game: C: the opening under the idea
G | F F | Em: bar 40 on the game landing
C | F | G | C: the ending, last chord on the logo
05-reason-to-show: C C: the opening under the hook
G | F F | Em: bar 40 on her photo landing
G | C: the ending, last chord on the logo
06-watch-make-show: C: the opening under the title
G | F F | Em: bar 40 on the first photo
C | F | G | C: the ending, last chord on the logo
07-made-by-10-year-old: C: the opening under the hook
G | F F | Em: bar 40 on the cartoon landing
C | F | G | C: the ending, last chord on the logo
08-will-ai-think: C C Am: the opening under the question (three bars: the reel grew by a bar for the spoken lines)
F F | G G | F: four bars that build, bar 40 on the answer
G | C: the ending, last chord on the logo
